title: Par Pacific Announces Closing of Laramie Energy Sale

Par Pacific Announces Closing of Laramie Energy Sale


HOUSTON, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Par Pacific Holdings, Inc. (NYSE and NYSE Texas: PARR) (“Par Pacific” or the “Company”) announced that Laramie Energy, LLC (“Laramie”) completed the previously announced sale of substantially all of its oil and gas assets on November 17, 2026, to an affiliate of Enbridge Inc. (the “Transaction”) and, in connection with the Transaction, Laramie redeemed Par Pacific’s 46% non-controlling ownership interest in Laramie.


Par Pacific received approximately $128 million in cash consideration from the Transaction. Par Pacific expects to receive approximately $28 million in additional cash consideration, payable on November 17, 2031, and may receive up to approximately $30 million in price-contingent earn-out payments over the next five years.


**About Par Pacific**


Par Pacific Holdings, Inc. (NYSE and NYSE Texas: PARR), headquartered in Houston, Texas, is a growing energy company providing both renewable and conventional fuels to the western United States. Par Pacific owns and operates 219,000 bpd of combined refining capacity across four locations in Hawaii, the Pacific Northwest and the Rockies, and an extensive energy infrastructure network, including 13 million barrels of storage, and marine, rail, rack, and pipeline assets. In addition, Par Pacific operates the Hele retail brand in Hawaii and the “nomnom” convenience store chain in the Pacific Northwest. More information is available at[www.parpacific.com](https://www.parpacific.com/) .
